question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated within living beings?
premises: A vital air is described as filled with breath
This air is present in beings
Its presence extends to all living beings
inference: Therefore the breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam is unusual and may reflect transmitted text.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
